name: Şebnem Gencer
bio_fr:
Istanbul-born international selling artist currently based in Australia. Originally from Türkiye, she lives and works exclusively from her Melbourne-based studio in Victoria.

Şebnem graduated from the Art Department of the Faculty of Art and Design at Doğuş University. She then went on to work with one of Istanbul’s most prestigious galleries for several years before relocating to Australia.

With widespread sales throughout Türkiye, the USA, Europe and Australia, her work appeals to both corporate and domestic markets. Her paintings are vibrantly colourful and highly textured, attracting collectors, home decorators and designers.

manifesto_fr:
For me, painting is deeply personal. It’s a way of finding comfort in the details of those fleeting moments and impressions that shape our lives. Love and loss leave their imprints, and my art becomes a canvas to explore these feelings, translating the invisible echoes of memory into something tangible. Each stroke, texture, and colour are an expression of growth, transformation, and resilience.

My art reflects how we move through the world, leaving traces of ourselves while carrying its beauty within us. Cityscapes, within every piece, I’m not just painting a view, I’m holding onto a moment, a love, a loss, a memory that shaped me. Through my work, I hope to create a space where others can also find their own memories and experiences reflected, wrapped in the same embrace that art has given me.
